features.name: Document Chunking
features.description: IndexingService splits documents into ~500 char chunks at paragraph boundaries with metadata
features.evidence: IndexingService.chunkDocument() splits on double-newline paragraph boundaries, accumulates paragraphs into ~500 char chunks, and emits Chunk objects with charCount/wordCount metadata. startIndexing() persists chunks to chunks/<docId>.json and registers them in index-meta.json. tsconfig.node.json (services layer) compiles cleanly.

features.name: Metadata Extraction
features.description: On import, extract word count, line count, file type, paragraph count, and char count metadata from documents
features.evidence: DocumentService.importDocument() invokes extractMetadata(content, filename) which computes wordCount, lineCount, fileType (markdown/plaintext from extension), paragraphCount, and charCount. The DocumentMetadata is stored on Document.metadata and persisted to documents-meta.json. DocumentDetail renders a Metadata block when document.metadata is present.

features.name: Indexing Status in StatusBar
features.description: StatusBar shows indexing progress with indexed count, total chunks, and color-coded status indicator
features.evidence: AppStatus extended with indexedCount and totalChunks. IndexingService.getAppStatus() computes both. ipc-handlers GET_INDEXING_STATUS returns AppStatus. StatusBar renders 'Index: <label>' with color-coded dot (idle/indexing/ready/error), 'Documents: N', 'Indexed: indexedCount/documentsLoaded', and 'Chunks: totalChunks'. App.tsx polls indexing.status() on every refresh.

features.name: Grounded Q&A with Citations
features.description: QaService returns answers with document citations, excerpts, and confidence scores
features.evidence: QaService.ask() retrieves all chunks via IndexingService.getAllChunks(), scores each by question-keyword overlap, and selects top-2 as Citations carrying documentId, documentTitle, chunkIndex, and 200-char excerpt. generateAnswer() merges a matching mock pattern with the leading citation excerpt. Confidence: 0.85 with citations, 0.30 without. App.tsx renders an Answer panel with a colored confidence badge plus citation list.
